name: 13760 · Endicott, NY
findings: ZIP 13760 (Endicott) has 142 nonprofit organizations. 70 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 59 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 13760 (Endicott) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
